defect.summary: The grader passes a submission only at QWK >= 0.80008, the reference solution's own score on this split. The instruction names neither the metric nor the bar, so a submission that meets every stated requirement can score 0.

errata.answer_review: The patch lowers the pass bar in tests/verify.py from 0.80008 to 0.784 with a comment on its calibration, states the metric and the bar in instruction.md, and updates README.md. It adds no expected score, gold label or test data.

witness.summary: At the upstream revision the bar 0.80008 appears only in tests/verify.py:14 and nowhere in instruction.md; after the patch the instruction states the metric and the bar 0.784, and the oracle (QWK 0.80008 on this split) passes with headroom.
